help.roles: A role groups permissions (e.g. Support or Warehouse). Assign roles to your users to control what they can see and change.

help.webhooks: Automatically notify your other systems (accounting, ERP, warehouse, CRM) when something happens in the store: a new order, a failed payment, low stock… Paste the address that system gives you and pick the events.
help.automation: Tasks that run on their own: e.g. message the customer when the order ships, or alert you when a refund arrives. They run on n8n, the store's automation tool.
help.audit: Log of who did what and when in the panel (price changes, cancelled orders, sign-ins). Useful to review mistakes or suspicious activity.
help.automationHealth: Success, failures, timings and versions of each workflow in real time.
help.automationTemplates: Preconfigured workflows: WhatsApp, inventory, invoice, segmentation, campaigns and win-back.
help.auditInsights: Activity summary, compliance controls with evidence (downloadable as PDF) and suspicious-activity detection.
